summary: London VOR/DME navigation beacon may show bearing fluctuations on radials 250 to 290 degrees due to a mobile crane nearby.
text:
VOR/DME LON/LONDON 113.60MHZ CH83X THERE MAY BE OBSERVATIONS OF

LONDON VOR/DME STATION, DUE TO MOBILE CRANE IN THE VCY
